source_claim: Bandai Namco Filmworks' official Accel World -Infinite Burst- page identifies Kurasaki Fuuko/Sky Raker by name and profiles her as a character in the official Accel World continuation. The page also directly profiles Arita Haruyuki and Kuroyukihime; these are the campaign members explicitly covered here.
notes: This title is an official sequel/continuation within the Accel World franchise; the proposed HOME remains the franchise root accel_world and does not create a separate home for Infinite Burst.
